description: This is a test suite for the MembershipService class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, focusing on testing membership-related operations such as list retrieval, fetching by ID, deletion, and fetching by name.

classes.name: MembershipServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the MembershipService functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of MembershipService and populates test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests that the getMembershipList method returns a list of Membership objects as expected.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests that the getMembershipById method correctly retrieves a Membership object by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Verifies that deleteMemberships method deletes specified memberships and returns the correct count.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests that the getMembershipByName method fetches the correct membership given a name.
